description: Election Commission - Declare that J. H. K. Sanjeewa Kumara as a member of the Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill the electoral vacancy, which falls directly under election-related matters concerning candidate nominations and declarations for local government positions.
